title: Payment Logs
description: Payment operations without Explore: live provider/mode (app_info), boot line, traceId trail, test-mode gate stream. Home folder: Cogito — one folder holds boards and alert rules.

panels.title: Provider identity (app_info)
panels.description: Live payment provider/mode from the app_info{version,provider,provider_mode} gauge (DEPENDENCY — emitted by the API; value is always 1). Shows the NoData-safe text until the API exposes it.

panels.title: Provider boot line
panels.description: Every API boot logs action=payment_provider_configured with the live provider and mode (e.g. provider=midtrans midtransMode=test). Missing after a deploy = the container never booted with the new env.

panels.title: Test-mode gate (FORBIDDEN)
panels.description: Purchases rejected by the provider-agnostic test-mode UAT list (XENDIT_TEST_ALLOWED_EMAILS). A burst here during UAT = allowlist misconfig, not a provider outage.
